suggestions.rationale: Clinical Mapping Master Resolution 2026 publishes this relationship only as treatment complication. Require documented oxaliplatin-containing colorectal-cancer chemotherapy and separately documented chemotherapy-induced peripheral neuropathy. Do not generalize to colorectal cancer without neurotoxic treatment. The cited literature supports only this bounded proposition and does not, by itself, establish an individual medical nexus.
evidenceGaps: Documentation of the qualifying treatment/procedure exposure for Colon / Rectal Cancer
Independent diagnosis of Peripheral Neuropathy and timing relative to that exposure
Dose, duration, procedure details, and relevant co-exposures where applicable
Qualified clinical assessment of competing causes and exact source-phenotype fit
